bio.text: Tina Polsky, a Democrat, represents District 30 in the Florida Senate, elected in 2020, and previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2018 to 2020.
According to the Florida Senate, Polsky is a mediator and lawyer with a B.A. from the University of Pennsylvania (1990) and a J.D. from Columbia University School of Law (1994).
The Senate lists Polsky as born in Merrick, New York, and as having moved to Florida in 2005.
